Collection Description
HW06 / Pool A / FR-06 - Product detail. Spec: GET /api/products/:id -> the product record. Generated from scripts/cases/api2_fr06_product_detail.py. This is the collection carrying the schema-validation evidence: the strict schema and the price-type assertions are repeated across every seeded product id, because type drift here is data-dependent and a single representative id would miss it. Fixtures always create their own throwaway products - the five seeded products are never modified or deleted, so no case can disturb another. --- CI REGRESSION GATE - generated, do not edit. Contains the 54 of 88 cases that passed the run recorded in reports/API2_FR06_ProductDetail.json. The remaining 34 fail because the SUT violates the specification; they are tracked in docs/bugs/BUG_REPORT.md, not here. Refresh with: python scripts/render-cases.py --api 2 --refresh-gate
